notes:
Did: components/preparation/knowledge-picker.tsx, a 'From past meetings' section rendered by SourcesPanel below Sources. It lists api_get_meetings as disclosure rows (button aria-expanded, chevron, 'Sep 27' date and title). Expanding one calls knowledge_get_meeting and offers items with eligibility true whose type is decision, commitment or question ('Decision · Sep 27', 'Open question · Sep 27'), each with an include dot (aria-pressed, 'Included in the brief: <text>'). The dot toggles {kind:'knowledge', meetingId, itemId} through SourcesPanel's shared select queue, so document and knowledge picks never overwrite each other. That queue now resolves to an error code (null on success), and each caller shows it. On SOURCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE the picker shows a toast ('That item can no longer be included. The list has been refreshed.'), reloads the expanded meetings and the meetings that selected items come from, and drops selected knowledge items that are no longer eligible, so the next save can land. Gallery screen preparation-knowledge-picker uses the base-ipc meetings and knowledge_get_meeting $byArg meetingId. No Rust change: knowledge_get_meeting already returns the eligibility flag that list_eligible_items filters on.
Learned: every test that renders SourcesPanel or PreparationPage now needs an api_get_meetings response (added to preparation-sources and preparation-page tests). base-ipc api_get_meetings has 3 meetings, so every preparation gallery screen now shows the 'From past meetings' section, collapsed. peek-inline-transcript light failed once more in the first full gate under load and passed on the rerun.
Assumptions: facts are not offered (the item names decisions, commitments and open questions), but pruning checks eligibility only, so a selected fact is never dropped. The meeting date is created_at, formatted en-US 'MMM d' in local time. A meeting whose knowledge fails to load shows "Couldn't load what this meeting found." in place, and its selected items are not pruned. Past meetings are not paginated.
